comment.text: Name of the left sidebar section that lists end-to-end encrypted private rooms, placed after Rooms and Forms and holding an Archive sub-item. Also the header and browser-tab title of that list, the root of its breadcrumbs, the section name inside Go to {{sectionName}}, an option of the default start page setting and the title of the E2E rooms app in the apps catalog. Plural section name (private rooms as a group), not a property of one item; keep it short, the sidebar is narrow.
